name: @spatulox/discord-interaction-manager
author: Spatulox
description: discord-interaction-manager is a lightweight CLI tool to manage Discord bot interactions (slash commands, context menus) in under 30 seconds. Deploy, update, delete, and generate interaction files with an interactive terminal interface.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run type-check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.patch: npm run build && npm version patch
scripts.minor: npm run build && npm version minor
scripts.major: npm run build && npm version major
scripts.pub:patch: npm run patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.pub:minor: npm run minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.pub:major: npm run major && npm publish --access public
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run cli
